title: Miletic GmbH
description: Miletic GmbH is a German specialized contractor headquartered in Bad Schönborn that has been operating in the construction sector since 1989. The company's core business focuses on construction and repair work for ecologically sensitive industrial facilities, including gas stations, tank farms, and operations governed by German water protection laws (WHG Class LAU facilities). Its service portfolio includes joint sealing and remediation, the application of chemical-resistant protective coatings, concrete construction, and related earthworks.
